links.scope_note_en: Approximation versus conditional exact execution: reconcile error quantifiers, graph families and training assumptions.
MPNN learned graph tasks do not construct immutable labels for pair-reachability.
Learned LOCAL message-passing is not parameterized transitive closure in an online index.
Dense graphon domain transfer and resolution discontinuity use nonidentical convergence models.
Dense graphon Lipschitz backbone does not match sparse succinct graph indexing.
GNN embedding continuity is not symmetry-preserving lossless graph compression.
Compare KV-cache savings with graph memory indexing: both ingest/update and warm/cold serving.
Workflow planning is not graph memory retrieval; keep simple lexical BM25 controls.
Run independent bounded-degree local-algorithm oracles with consistent precision and error.
Use coarsening/refinement pairs to separate query truth and embedding continuity.
Compare a graph workflow to a non-graph baseline at equal model and cache budgets.

model_bridges.boundary: Learned BFS/LOCAL execution does not supply adaptive online exact DAG reachability with immutable labels and paid writes.
Rank and adaptive observation queries are not NTK finite-precision local MLP training guarantees.
Learned embedding stability does not imply Byzantine freshness, authenticated history or causal information preservation.
Learned representation stability and KV-cache savings do not price disk page rewrites, WAL or physical I/O.
